text:
sam_pm: Quick thread 1212 we need 3 design partners for a compact Private+Dedicated pilot focused on routing resilience, KMS handoff, and a repeatable ops-onboarding checklist. Goal: validate onboarding <72h and rollback playbook. Shortlist by Thu.

indra_se: I can own the SDK quickstart and a tiny tracing tool to capture fallback events. ETA Wed. Will add a minimal health endpoint smoke test.

morgan_ops: Ops constraints: require either VPC peering or customer VPN; some partners will only accept hosted-edge. I'll prepare a 1-page matrix of options + time-to-enable.

zara_research: Draft acceptance criteria (product): p50/p95 on a 10-prompt set, fallback success >= 99%, onboarding <3 dev-days, and nightly auto-eval >= 90% for extraction prompts. We'll require one sample prompt + expected output pre-onboard.

sam_pm: Incentives: $3k platform credit + prioritized infra support during pilot + joint post-pilot writeup (opt-in). Leaner than earlier threads but faster. Thoughts?

morgan_ops: Add to pre-onboard checklist: IP allowlist, KMS test key, contact for firewall approvals, and a maintenance window preference. I'll paste a template.

indra_se: Quickstart will include this curl to exercise routing + fallback logs: ```curl -X POST https://private.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DP_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-route-beta","prompt":"exercise fallback","timeout_ms":900}'``` That emits a trace id we can map back to partner.

zara_research: Eval plan: 3 families - convo, extraction, and short code. I'll produce the 10 prompts and an automated nightly runner. Partners can opt to run locally or allow us to run against a canned dataset.

legal-bot: NDA "Design Partner" v2026-05-10 available: https://redwood.docs/nda-dp. Use this in invites.

sam_pm: Owners: @indra_se quickstart, @morgan_ops infra, @zara_research metrics/evals, @sam_pm outreach. Shortlist Thu, invites Fri AM. Success to expand: 2/3 partners meet perf + onboarding SLOs; otherwise extend pilot and iterate.

morgan_ops: Will add rollback knobs: auto-split to hosted 80/20 on p95 breach >10m; full rollback after 30m. Will post the playbook link shortly.

indra_se: I'll drop the repo link and a 2-min demo clip into this thread once ready.

sam_pm: Thanks everyone 12 update the shared sheet when you claim an owner. Keeping it tight.
